paper_title: Optimization of PDTS-DTffBT-Based Solar Cell Performance through Control of Polymer Molecular Weight

knowledge_points.content: PDTS-DTffBT is a donor-acceptor (D-A) copolymer synthesized using dithieno[3,2-b:2',3'-d]silole (DTS) as the donor unit and fluorinated benzothiadiazole (DTffBT) as the acceptor unit.
knowledge_points.evidence: Recently, we reported a new D-A copolymer of poly{4,4'-bis(2-ethylhexyl)dithieno[3,2-b:2',3'-d]silole-alt-5,6-difluoro-4,7-bis(4-hexylthiophen-2-yl)-2,1,3-benzothiadiazole} (PDTS-DTffBT) containing dithieno[3,2-b:2',3'-d]silole (DTS) and fluorinated benzothiadiazole (DTffBT) units.

knowledge_points.content: The molecular weight of PDTS-DTffBT was controlled by varying polymerization temperatures (95 °C to 110 °C) and reaction times (24 h to 32 h) during the Stille coupling reaction.
knowledge_points.evidence: PDTS-DTffBT with three different MWs (Mn) = 9, 16, 36 kDa, were synthesized... the 36 kDa fraction... stirred at 110 °C for 32 h... the 16 kDa fraction was stirred at 110 °C for 28 h... while the 9 kDa fraction was stirred at 95 °C for 24 h.

knowledge_points.content: Increasing the number-average molecular weight (Mn) of PDTS-DTffBT from 9 kDa to 36 kDa causes the maximum absorption peak to red-shift from 560 nm to 579 nm in solution and the optical bandgap to decrease from 1.61 eV to 1.57 eV in films.
knowledge_points.evidence: As the MW increased from 9 to 36 kDa, the maximum absorption peak red-shifted from 560 to 579 nm... The optical bandgaps of polymers were 1.61, 1.58, and 1.57 eV for a Mn of 9, 16, and 36 kDa respectively.

knowledge_points.content: The highest occupied molecular orbital (HOMO) energy level of PDTS-DTffBT up-shifts from -5.37 eV to -5.25 eV as the molecular weight increases from 9 kDa to 36 kDa.
knowledge_points.evidence: We find that the HOMO energy level exhibits a positive dependence on molecular weight, rising from -5.37 to -5.25 eV as Mn increased from 9 to 36 kDa.

knowledge_points.content: The power conversion efficiency (PCE) of PDTS-DTffBT:PC71BM solar cells significantly improves from 2.49% to 6.40% as the polymer molecular weight increases from 9 kDa to 36 kDa.
knowledge_points.evidence: The best PCE of 6.40% was achieved by the devices based on the PDTS-DTffBT with a Mn value of 36 kDa... the final PCE of PSCs based on 9 kDa PDTS-DTffBT was much lower (2.49%).

knowledge_points.content: The open-circuit voltage (Voc) of PDTS-DTffBT based devices decreases from 0.83 V to 0.67 V as the molecular weight increases, which is attributed to the up-shifted HOMO level of the higher molecular weight polymer.
knowledge_points.evidence: The Voc suffered an apparent decline as the MW increased from 9 to 16 kDa, which corresponds with the up-shifted HOMO energy levels... the 9 kDa PDTS-DTffBT based device exhibited the highest Voc of 0.83 V.

knowledge_points.content: Hole mobility in PDTS-DTffBT:PC71BM blend films, measured by the space-charge limited current (SCLC) method, increases from 4.76 x 10^-5 cm^2 V^-1 s^-1 for 9 kDa to 2.21 x 10^-4 cm^2 V^-1 s^-1 for 36 kDa.
knowledge_points.evidence: The calculated mobility data showed that... when the MW increased from 9 to 16 kDa, the hole mobility increased by a factor of 3. Further increasing MW to 36 kDa the mobility increased from 1.47 x 10^-4 to 2.21 x 10^-4 cm^2 V^-1 s^-1.

knowledge_points.content: High molecular weight PDTS-DTffBT (36 kDa) results in a homogeneous blend morphology with significantly reduced domain sizes compared to the 9 kDa version, which exhibits ridged-like morphology and larger aggregates.
knowledge_points.evidence: For the PDTS-DTffBT(9 kDa):PC71BM film, a ridged-like nanoscale morphology can be observed with a relatively big aggregation size... blend film processed by the highest MW PDTS-DTffBT was homogeneous with significantly reduced domain size.

knowledge_points.content: The optimized active layer for PDTS-DTffBT:PC71BM solar cells uses a 1:2 weight ratio and is processed from a mixed solvent of 1,2-dichlorobenzene (DCB) with 3% 1,8-diiodooctane (DIO) as an additive.
knowledge_points.evidence: We dissolved 10 mg of polymers... and 20 mg of PC71BM in a mixed solvent containing 970 uL of DCB and 30 uL of 1,8-diiodooctane (DIO)... (1:2 weight ratio).

knowledge_points.content: The external quantum efficiency (EQE) peak value increases from less than 30% for the 9 kDa PDTS-DTffBT device to 63.6% for the 36 kDa device, indicating more efficient charge collection and exciton dissociation in the high MW polymer.
knowledge_points.evidence: Clearly, the low MW polymer based device offered the lowest EQE value (less than 30%)... the peak EQE value up to 54.3 and 63.6% for 16 and 36 kDa, respectively.
